plain: Generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival

webster.text: Great of mind; elevated in soul or in sentiment; brave; disinterested; as a magnanimous prince or general.

example.quote: Our country has received from that kingdom the highest proof of favors which a magnanimous power can show: nor are there any grounds to suspect a diminution of its friendship.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
